# Bramha Dalvi

> UX designer for games with 7+ years turning player engagement into revenue. Portfolio and case studies for roles as **game designer**, **product manager for games**, **UX designer for games**, and **data analyst for games**.

## Start here (for LLMs and AI crawlers)

1. This file — `/llms.txt` (you are here)
2. Extended context — [/llms-full.txt](https://bramha.work/llms-full.txt)

## Case studies (indexed, high signal)

- [Guild of Guardians](https://bramha.work/work/guild-of-guardians): Live mobile RPG — Feature Owner & Lead UX Designer. Data analysis and feature design; **+25% D7 retention**, **+12% D7 LTV**. Tags: mobile RPG, data analysis, feature design, live product. Client: Immutable.
- [Rocksmith+](https://bramha.work/work/rocksmith): Music learning game — UX Lead for mobile & multi-platform. Single scalable UI across **5 platforms**. Client: Ubisoft. Tags: PC/console/mobile, accessibility, unified input systems.
